text:
anya: quick question — thinking about the automatic fallback UX for rollouts. we currently show a single toggle + a sampling % field. feels too blunt for operators.
sam: agree. operators want a clear 'why did we fallback' trail and lightweight ack flow. :thinking_face:
devin: do we surface triggers in the UI? e.g. 5xx spike, p95 latency, queue depth? or just show an aggregated reason?
maria: we should show the top triggered signals + the rule that fired. short list, not raw metrics. something like: 'trigger: 5xx_rate>1.5% (10m)' and a link to the telemetry panel.
anya: +1. also need an on-call-friendly sampling policy: default low sampling for audit (1%) but auto-escalate to 100% when fallback persists >5m or when rollouts hit X% traffic. operators asked for this in last oncall.
sam: UX idea — two-tier sampling control: baseline sample_rate and escalation window. expose both inline in the rollout card. e.g. baseline=1%, escalate_after=300s -> 100%.
devin: implementation detail: API param names? current backend expects fallback.sample and fallback.mode. i'd prefer explicit names: fallback.audit_sample_rate, fallback.escalation_after_s, fallback.escalation_rate.
maria: nit: show human-friendly labels in console + hover tooltip that maps back to API names. avoid exposing raw field keys to normal users.
ops-bot: INCIDENT BOT: detected fallback triggered on rollout/blue-42 — 5xx_rate=2.1% over 10m. Sampling auto-ramped to 100%.
anya: nice. for operator ack do we require a sticky override? proposal: operator can acknowlege fallback and set sticky_override=true for N minutes. needs audit entry with name, reason.
sam: add a small 'reason' text box on ack modal. auto-fill with most-likely signal but allow edits. store in audit logs. :memo:
devin: worried about noise — can we make ack optional but capture operator dismissal as a lower-severity audit event? require ack only for production rollouts >10% traffic.
maria: i like gradation. add a small badge on the rollout row: 'fallback active — auto' vs 'fallback active — acked by maria'.
anya: below is a config sketch for the API. pls review:
```
fallback_policy:
  mode: "gentle"   # options: off, gentle, strict
  audit_sample_rate: 0.01
  escalation_after_s: 300
  escalation_sample_rate: 1.0
  triggers:
    - name: "5xx_rate"
      window_mins: 10
      threshold_pct: 1.5
    - name: "p95_latency_ms"
      window_mins: 10
      threshold_ms: 500
```
devin: looks good. one ask: include a compact trace-id in the audit entry so we can jump to full playback.
sam: for the console, UI affordances: small inline 'why' pill, 'ack' button, 'escalate sampling' toggle (read-only unless you have operator role), and link to playback.
anya: accessibility: keyboard-first ack and quick-forms. also keep mobile-friendly since oncall uses mobile slack -> webview.
maria: tagging: when fallback fires, attach rollout commit hash + canary cohort id to the audit. helps root cause.
devin: I'll update the API proto and add audit_trace_id. sam/maria, can one of you do a quick mock for the rollout card with these affordances?
sam: i'll sketch a compact card tomorrow morning.
maria: i'll collect the audit fields we need and draft the modal copy.
anya: thanks. leaving this as action items: devin -> proto + trace_id, sam -> mock, maria -> audit modal copy. follow up in design sync on friday. :pray:
